patch_description: This redesign separates the algorithm into feature extraction, robust state tracking, and hysteretic output control stages. A multiscale causal regression bank produces endpoint estimates, slopes, and residual-noise scales. A robust constant-velocity tracker supplies low-lag predictions, while discrete flat/trend modes prevent continuously changing gains from creating gain jitter and false reversals. Trend mode requires consecutive high-confidence windows, while returning to flat mode requires several low-confidence windows. Direction changes are independently confirmed with volatility-scaled hysteresis.
